projects.title: Gym-Clickr (demo)
projects.description: A little clicker game where you can buy upgrades to increase your clicks per second. The demo is built with vanilla JavaScript. The full game will be built with React.js and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, and Express.js, Node.js, and MongoDB for the backend to handle user data and game state.

projects.title: Skivio
projects.description: A responsive KanBan task board web app built with React.JS, Tailwind.CSS and Dexie.js (for IndexedDB), designed to give an intuitive drag-and-drop workflow for managing projects and tasks.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A web application where users can check the weather in different cities. It fetches data from a weather API and displays current temperature, and weather conditions. Users can also favorite cities for quick access.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.description: The very portfolio you are looking at right now! Built with React.js and Tailwind CSS, featuring smooth scrolling and animations powered by Lenis and Framer Motion.

projects.title: CoachPlate
projects.description: CoachPlate is a SaaS platform I built for nutrition coaches and personal trainers. It features AI-assisted meal plan and training program generation, client management, and branded PDF exports - all in one place. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and the Anthropic API.
